description: List the curated template library: finished, deployed page designs (landing pages, shops, portfolios …) that can be adopted as the starting point of a NEW app instead of building from scratch. Each entry has a live URL and a screenshot URL plus kind/industries/tags for matching. Adopting a matching template is far cheaper and better-looking than writing a page from zero — check here FIRST on any first build.
